value.question: Explain in simple words what a Phase II trial is and who can join one.
plan: Phase II tests if a treatment works and has few side effects.
It involves more patients than Phase I.
People with the disease are usually included.

value.draft: A Phase II trial checks if a treatment works and has few side effects. It involves more patients than Phase I and usually includes people who have the disease being studied. These trials help find the best dose and learn more about how the treatment affects the condition. Participants are often people who already have the illness and are looking for new treatment options. They are carefully selected to ensure safety and effective results.

value.feedback: The draft clearly explains Phase II trials and who can join, but could mention that participants are typically those with the disease and may have tried other treatments.
